content.comment_body: I need to connect a [product_name] module to Wonderware WSP. Currently, I have two PLCs of type [version_no] connected, and they work fine, but I can't get [product_name] to connect. The [product_name] module is set up with one ethernet connection to the server and allows all connections. I use DASServer for [company_name]. I just want to read signals, such as Q1. I've tried to read Q1 or Q0.0, but it doesn't work. Thanks in advance, and apologies for my English.

Hello [user_name], which protocol does Wonderware use? In [product_name] software, you can find an overview of the variable memory, including addresses for inputs and outputs. Try using these specific addresses.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having issues connecting a [product_name] module to Wonderware WSP using DASServer for [company_name], specifically with reading output signals like Q1 or Q0.0, while similar reading works fine with two [version_no] PLCs. It is suggested to use the address references available in the [product_name] software to assist with correct signal reading.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to read output signals from the [product_name] module in Wonderware WSP as smoothly and reliably as with the [version_no] PLCs.
